messages.subject: WG: dbDRiver - PostgreSQL
messages.body_plain:
Dear Dev Crew,

 

i have maybe an easy question to solve but googling around couldn't help me
at allL

 

I am able to set a connection between R and the postgre database.

 

But the problem I have is the following.

 

I need to access an other schema and not the main (public) one.

 

But this example is not working.

dataframe  <- dbReadTable(con,"schema2.table")

 

How can I tell him which is the needed schema??

 

Thanks for the help!

 

Kind regards,

Holger
